# AutoFactory

> Get 3D models manufactured through an agent-friendly API. Upload a model,
> choose a material, get a quote, and send the buyer a checkout link.

Agents handle quoting and order updates. The buyer completes hosted checkout.
New API keys need activation. The API reports current materials, limits, prices
and order state.

## Agent instructions

- [AutoFactory skill](https://autofactory.build/skill.md): Start here for quoting and order tracking.
- [API workflow](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/autofactory-build/autofactory-skill/main/skills/autofactory/references/api-workflow.md): Task references and HTTP examples.
- [Troubleshooting](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/autofactory-build/autofactory-skill/main/skills/autofactory/references/troubleshooting.md): Activation, rate limits and request recovery.

## Optional

- [Skill repository](https://github.com/autofactory-build/autofactory-skill): Source and installation instructions.
